note: Cherry-made Model House sets. No Model House set survives in the original game archives, so every set code, name, description and price here is Cherry's own invention (AGENTS, Operator-editable fabricated content). The element item codes are real Interior Shop furniture. Price rule: the sum of the elements' Gem prices (interior_price 150; WA and TI 100 in prices.json) less 10 percent, in whole Gems.
